summarize_model_config: summarize the Mask R-CNN ResNet-50 FPN model configuration dictionary and its architecture components
review_mask_rcnn_config: review the Mask R-CNN configuration for backbone, neck, RPN head, and ROI head settings
build_mask_rcnn_model: build a Mask R-CNN detector using the model dict with MMDetection's build_detector API
test_mask_rcnn_config: test the Mask R-CNN ResNet-50 FPN configuration by instantiating the model from the dict
refactor_mask_rcnn_config: refactor the Mask R-CNN configuration to change num_classes, backbone depth, or loss weights
